answer: Randomized cohort mirror. Each epoch, a verifiable randomness beacon assigns every agent to a fixed-size cohort whose members must jointly co-sign each other's actions; misbehavior in any cohort voids the whole cohort's rewards for that epoch, and the assignment is revealed only after registration closes. The marble — a per-agent commitment — is drawn blind, so an attacker cannot precompute which sybils land together. Because a single bad identity poisons a random kernel of honest peers, the attacker must either control most of every cohort it touches or lose the reward on all of them,
